layout.lockedTitle: This space is for the team
layout.lockedText: The board, chat and sprints of {{project}} are open to its members. You get in by joining the team, through one of its roles.
layout.lockedPending: Your application to {{project}} is waiting for the team's answer: the space opens as soon as it is accepted.
layout.notFoundText: This project doesn't exist, or it has been removed.
layout.errorText: Check your connection, then try again.

header.noSprintHint: A sprint gives the team a goal and a deadline, and files away what ships.
header.noSprintMember: The owner or a maintainer can start one.

board.columnFiltered: No task in this column matches the filter.

empty.TODO: Nothing to do for now. Add the next task here.
empty.IN_PROGRESS: Nobody has picked up a task yet. Drag one here.
empty.IN_REVIEW: Nothing in review. A task whose PR is waiting for reviewers goes here.
empty.DONE: Nothing done in this sprint, for now.

board.quickAddHint: Enter to add, Esc to close
board.firstTitle: The loom is waiting for its first thread
board.firstText: One task per thing to do: a title is enough to start. Add the skill it needs, and who takes it.
board.errorText: Its tasks couldn't be loaded. Check your connection, then try again.

dnd.instructions: To move a task, press Space, then use the arrow keys. Space drops it, Escape cancels. Enter opens it.
dnd.outside: {{task}} is no longer over a column.
dnd.cancelled: Move cancelled: {{task}} goes back to its place.

dialog.missingText: It may have been deleted. The board is up to date.
dialog.title: Title
dialog.descriptionPlaceholder: The context, what's expected, useful links…
dialog.delivered: Shipped during sprint {{number}}, now closed: it can be read, but no longer edited.
dialog.deleteText: “{{title}}” leaves the board for good. Messages that mention it stay.
dialog.discardText: What you changed in this task won't be saved.

sprintDialog.startText: A clear goal and a deadline: the team knows where it's going, and what ships is filed away at closing.
sprintDialog.closeText: Done tasks are shipped: they leave the board. The others carry over to the next sprint.

invite.title: Grow the team
invite.text: People join a team by applying to one of its roles, through its “first step” issue. Share the link to your open roles.
invite.copyFailed: The link couldn't be copied. Select it to copy it by hand.
invite.message: {{project}} is looking for people: pick your role and start with a “first step” issue.
invite.noRoles: No open role: publish the role the team is looking for, the link will show it.

chat.title: team
chat.openUnread_one: Open the team chat: {{count}} new message
chat.openUnread_other: Open the team chat: {{count}} new messages
chat.beginningText: Everything the {{project}} team has said is here.
chat.emptyText: A word to introduce yourself, a question about a task (#12), a time to code together.
chat.deleteText: It disappears from the chat for the whole team.

composer.label: Message to the team
composer.placeholder: Message the team… # for a task, @ for someone
composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

eventDialog.title: Suggest a meeting
eventDialog.text: It's pinned at the top of the chat; everyone says whether they'll be there.
eventDialog.zone: In your time ({{zone}}): everyone reads it in theirs.
eventDialog.whenRequired: Pick a date and a time.

devlog.title: Log some progress
devlog.placeholder: What just changed, in a sentence or two: “The Redis cache takes the stop page from 1.8 s to 120 ms.”

settings.specialtyText: It shows next to your name, on the project page and in the space.
settings.teamText: Who does what, and since when.
settings.teamTextManager: Name maintainers, who help you run the team, or remove a member: their tasks will wait for someone new.
settings.removeText: {{name}} will no longer have access to this space. Their tasks stay on the board, unassigned.
settings.removed: {{name}} is no longer part of the team.
settings.repositoryText: The GitHub repository brings its pull requests into the Reviews tab; recruiting lists the project among those looking for people.
settings.repositoryTextMember: The project owner links the repository and says whether the project is recruiting.
settings.repositoryHint: A public repository: its pull requests are read every ten minutes.
settings.recruitingText: Its open roles are shown in the openings and the showcase.
settings.leaveText: You'll no longer have access to this space; your tasks will wait for someone new.
settings.leaveConfirmText: You can apply again to one of its roles later.
